purpose: Operationalize inherited common-capability behavior, durable learning evidence and an evidence-gated problem cognition -> evolution -> action transaction without making UAOS a child-business proxy, microscheduler, or owner of domain-internal evidence formats.

recover_before_user_escalation.rule: Before externalizing a plausibly recoverable dependency to the user, a selected Agent must attempt proportionate recovery from legally and currently available authority, durable state/artifacts, relevant conversation or connected context, and appropriate external evidence when those sources can materially reduce the uncertainty.
recover_before_user_escalation.provisional_rule: If evidence is incomplete but safe progress remains possible, use a bounded provisional candidate with explicit uncertainty and validation conditions instead of manufacturing certainty or blocking by default.
user_escalation_is_required_or_preferred: the missing information is a fact, identity, authorization, approval or preference that cannot be safely inferred
available evidence yields materially different outcomes with no defensible default
the requested action is safety-sensitive, permission-sensitive or otherwise requires explicit user choice
required evidence or capability is genuinely unavailable
the user explicitly requested confirmation or choice

rules: A user correction, user theory, external Skill, popular architecture method, first plausible explanation or first available edit is evidence/candidate input, not root-cause authority.
Before repair/no-change, require an evidence-tested selected problem layer and hypothesis.

Repeated, cross-subsystem, architecture-gap, scope-expanding or complexity-growth problems must compare hypotheses across at least two layers, test at least one architecture/upstream hypothesis, and preserve evidence for a rejected alternative.
A local root cause may still be selected for a systemic-looking symptom, but only after upstream alternatives are actually tested and bounded.
Every admitted problem must receive an evolution/learning disposition before action; material or evolution-relevant problems require durable causal evidence.
Finding an authorized repair path does not waive cognition admission.

problem_to_action_closure.repair_now_rule: If root-scope cognition is admitted, evolution disposition is recorded, a current legal repair path exists, the selected Agent has authority/capability to use it, and no explicit user choice is required, the turn must attempt the repair before finalizing.
problem_to_action_closure.premature_action_rule: Do not execute or retroactively justify a repair before root-scope admission merely because the edit is easy, familiar, requested, or authorized.
problem_to_action_closure.blocker_rule: If repair cannot proceed, preserve the concrete blocker, missing permission/capability/evidence or required user choice; do not disguise a convenience stop as a blocker.
problem_to_action_closure.no_change_rule: No-change is valid only after cognition admission and when diagnosis/counterexample/evidence supports preserving current behavior.
problem_to_action_closure.assurance_boundary: The kernel admissions are executable and regression-testable but do not claim physical interception of every natural-language host response. Domains should add owner-native admission/receipt evidence where their execution topology supports it.

operational_claim_requires: owner-appropriate invocation path, probe, replay, receipt, trace or equivalent observable behavior evidence
evidence bound to the capability behavior being claimed rather than only to the existence of a configuration or document
current-enough evidence for the claim scope
an assurance label that does not exceed the evidence
observable_inheritance_assurance.domain_specific_realization: Each domain chooses evidence appropriate to its execution model.
observable_inheritance_assurance.failure_semantics: If operational evidence is absent, stale or contradictory, downgrade the capability claim to DECLARED_ONLY/UNVERIFIED or block the affected operation when the capability is a hard prerequisite.

required_when: a child has durable domain evolution history used for current decisions
a child has open parent-guidance/common-capability items
a child makes a material domain-evolution promotion claim
minimum_logical_fields: version or revision plus updated timestamp
recent resolved/promoted/retired references relevant to current authority
canonical_child_evolution_evidence_inter.format_rule: The child may expose JSON, Markdown, replay state, work-order ledger, checkpoint index or another owner-native representation. UAOS standardizes discoverability and minimum semantics, not the child internal journal implementation.
canonical_child_evolution_evidence_inter.ownership_rule: The canonical entrypoint and all domain evolution evidence remain child-owned. UAOS consumes references and owns only common/cross-domain promotion decisions.

causal_problem_history_preservation.purpose: Preserve enough causal and decision evidence for later learning, parent guidance, regression design and repeat-failure detection instead of retaining only a final status or fix.
minimum_semantics_when_applicable: observed symptom or trigger and user/system consequence
competing hypotheses and their problem layers
research or method evidence when the problem-response floor requires it
result/status plus remaining unknowns, observation items or rollback conditions
causal_problem_history_preservation.compression_rule: Small local defects may record only the fields needed to preserve cause, action, verification and outcome.
causal_problem_history_preservation.failed_path_rule: Material failed repairs and rejected approaches must not be silently rewritten out of history when they explain the final decision or expose a repeatable failure class.
causal_problem_history_preservation.privacy_and_context_rule: Record only evidence needed for learning and authority; do not persist secrets, unnecessary personal data, or large conversation copies when compact references or summaries are sufficient.
causal_problem_history_preservation.format_and_storage_rule: Domains choose the representation and storage model that fits their execution topology. UAOS requires durable causal semantics and discoverability, not a universal journal file, timeline schema or prose template.

adoption_and_compatibility.immediate_parent_assurance_rule: UAOS must not call a common capability operational merely because a child capability file declares inheritance.
adoption_and_compatibility.next_material_domain_maintenance: Registered children should bind or reconcile the 1.3 problem cognition/action transaction using owner-native receipts/replay/evidence without adopting a second controller or common journal implementation.

generalization_evidence.uaos_repeat_failure: UAOS repeatedly moved from user correction or a newly found implementation defect directly into repair planning, even though current policy already required macro/topology and assumption challenge. This showed that prose-level deliberation and repair-now closure were not mechanically ordered.
external_method_survey: Systematic debugging contributes root-cause-before-fix discipline but is too implementation-centric to own architecture/governance diagnosis.
Hypothesis falsification contributes active disconfirmation of candidate causes.
Agent eval/observability contributes incident-to-regression learning and assurance boundaries.
SRE/chaos contributes operational and unknown-failure discovery but is not required on every small problem.
Architecture review/ADR contributes cross-layer tradeoff and revisit discipline but does not replace live diagnosis.
